items.title: The B2B Product-Led Growth Maturity Model
items.author: OpenView / Wes Bush
items.description: A maturity framework for B2B companies adopting PLG. Covers four stages: awareness, activation, expansion, and advocacy with specific metrics and tactics per stage.

items.title: The Complete Guide to B2B SaaS Pricing and Packaging
items.author: Kyle Poyar (OpenView)
items.description: Comprehensive guide on usage-based pricing, tiered plans, per-seat vs consumption, and packaging strategy for B2B SaaS. Includes data from 300+ companies.

items.title: How to Run B2B Customer Discovery Interviews That Don't Suck
items.author: Alex Clayton
items.description: Practical template and script for B2B discovery interviews. Covers identifying power users, finding the economic buyer, and questions that reveal real budgets.

items.title: Product-Led Sales: How to Align Product and Sales Teams
items.author: First Round Review
items.description: How Atlassian, GitLab, and Datadog structure product-led sales motions. Covers PQL scoring, sales-assist signals, and when to hand off from product to sales.

items.title: B2B Product Roadmap Prioritization for Enterprise Accounts
items.author: Maggie Crowley (Drift/PagerDuty)
items.description: How to handle multi-tenant feature requests, enterprise deal-driven roadmaps, and balancing top-down strategy with bottom-up customer needs. Includes ICE and RICE adaptations for B2B.

items.title: The API Product Manager's Guide to Platform Strategy
items.author: Kin Lane
items.description: Guide to managing APIs as products in B2B platform companies. Covers developer portals, API versioning, deprecation strategies, and developer relations.

items.title: Designing B2B Onboarding That Proves Value in 30 Days
items.author: Lincoln Murphy / Sixteen Ventures
items.description: Time-to-value framework for B2B SaaS. Covers adoption milestones, success plans, and how product can reduce time-to-first-value through in-app guidance.

items.title: B2B Churn Analysis: Causes, Metrics, and Prevention
items.author: Christoph Janz / Point Nine Capital
items.description: Deep analysis of why B2B companies churn. Covers logo churn vs. dollar churn, multi-threading risk, and build vs. buy triggers in enterprise procurement.

items.title: B2B Competitive Differentiation Without Feature Parity
items.author: April Dunford
items.description: Positioning strategy for B2B products that can't out-feature incumbents. Covers market context, alternative-based positioning, and the value wedge framework.

items.title: B2B Buyer Persona Research: Building ICPs That Drive Product Decisions
items.author: Michele Hansen
items.description: Method for creating B2B ideal customer profiles based on qualitative research. Covers job-to-be-done interviews, persona segmentation, and persona-driven validation.
